net sales.heading: Revenue
net sales.text: We perform a significant amount of our services under master service agreements and other contracts that contain customer-specified service requirements. These agreements include discrete pricing for individual tasks including, for example, the placement of underground or aerial fiber, directional boring, and fiber splicing, each based on a specific unit of measure. Revenue is recognized over time as services are performed and customers simultaneously receive and consume the benefits we provide. Output measures, such as units delivered or milestones completed, are utilized to assess progress against specific contractual performance obligations for a portion of our services. For a majority of our services, revenue is recognized at a point in time as it is dependent upon successful completion of the performance obligations in the contract.

net sales.heading: Revenue
net sales.text:
Revenue was $461.5 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $309.2 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025. Revenue from businesses acquired in 2026 and 2025 were $145.1 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026. Acquired revenue represents revenue from acquired businesses that were not owned for the entire three months ended September 30, 2025.

Excluding amounts generated by the acquired businesses, revenue increased by $7.3 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025 as a result of the expansion of organic volume growth and geographic expansion across our E&M and Infrastructure Deployment service lines.

intro.text: ITG is a leading provider of end-to-end services to the communications and digital infrastructure industries throughout the United States. ITG supports the planning, design, construction, operation, maintenance, and expansion of broadband, wireless, data center, utility, and civil infrastructure. With a workforce operating across 49 states, ITG is positioned to build and maintain the digital backbone powering our future.
